offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells pneumatic compression devices and related therapy systems for treating lymphedema and chronic venous disease. Devices are used by patients at home and in clinics, and are often provided through rental or sale, with reimbursement from insurers.

primary_products.value: pneumatic compression therapy devices; compression garments and sleeves; therapy controllers

customer_segment.value: B2B: home health agencies, clinics and therapy providers that prescribe or dispense devices; B2C: individual patients with lymphedema or venous disease who use devices at home

end_markets.value: healthcare; home healthcare; lymphedema and wound care

revenue_model.value: product sales: devices and garments sold or rented to patients and providers; healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare and private insurers for prescribed therapy devices

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes therapy devices, sold to providers and patients; brand owner: markets its own branded devices through its sales force and providers

geography_served.value: US national: sells across the United States through a national sales force and provider network

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on lymphedema and venous therapy devices and related garments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales representatives calling on clinics and home health agencies; partners / resellers: third-party providers and distributors that supply devices to patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance, Medicare and insurer coverage rules for reimbursement
